system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (14).
Once per long rest on a success, you
create a stack of false targeting
profiles, AR ghosts, signal echoes,
movement loops, or false targeting
data over your body that makes it hard
to tell exactly where you are.
Mark any number of Stress to make
that many additional layers.
When an adversary makes an attack
against you, roll a number of d6s equal
to the number of layers currently
active.
If any roll as or higher, one layer of the
decoy loop is destroyed and the attack
fails. a
If all the results are 4 or lower, you take
the damage and this protocol ends.
